title: 不: not
summary: Lets you say no or not by putting 不 before a verb or adjective, as in 我不是老师 and 我不忙.
explanation:
不 means "not" or "don't". It is the most common way to say no in Chinese: 我不忙 (I'm not busy), 他不喝茶 (he doesn't drink tea), 我不是老师 (I'm not a teacher).

To build it, put 不 right before the verb or adjective (a describing word like 忙 or 冷). The verb itself never changes. With adjectives, you usually drop 很, so 我很忙 becomes 我不忙. With 是, just say 不是.

Use 不 for things that are true now, for habits, for what you like or want, and for plans: 我明天不去 (I'm not going tomorrow). One small sound change: 不 is said with a rising tone before a falling-tone word, as in 不是 and 不去. The app's pinyin shows this.

The big contrast is 不 vs 没有. Use 没有 for things that didn't happen in the past (我昨天没有去) and to say "don't have": always say 没有, never 不有.

examples.en: I'm not going to school tomorrow.

examples.zh: 我妈妈不喜欢猫，她喜欢狗。
examples.en: My mom doesn't like cats. She likes dogs.

mistakes.why: 有 is never negated with 不. Always use 没有.
For something that didn't happen in the past, use 没有, not 不.
不 goes before the verb, so it comes before 是, not after it.

why: Correct: 不 negates likes and habits, so 不喜欢 means "don't like".
没有 is for things that didn't happen in the past. For likes and habits, use 不.
是 means "am/is", not "not". It can't make 喜欢 negative.
没有 is for past actions or "don't have". To say an adjective is not true, use 不.
Don't add 是 before an adjective. Say 不冷, not 不是冷.
Correct: 不 goes straight before the adjective, so 不冷 means "not cold".
有 is never negated with 不. 不有 is always wrong.
Correct: 有 is negated as 没有, meaning "doesn't have".
很 means "very" and doesn't make the sentence negative.
不 must come before the verb 是, not after it.
Correct: 不是 + noun means "am not a…".
是 is negated with 不, never with 没有.
You still need 是 between 我 and a noun: 我不是学生.

exercises.prompt: Which means "I'm not going to school tomorrow"?
why: 没有 is for things that didn't happen. For plans and the future, use 不.
不 goes before the verb 去, not after it.
Correct: 不 goes right before the verb, and 不 is used for future plans.
To say "not busy", use 不, not 没有.
Correct: drop 很 and put 不 before the adjective, so you get 我不忙.
Don't use 是 with an adjective. Just say 不忙.
Adjectives don't take 是. The simple form is 我不忙.
Correct: put 不 right before 是, so 不是 means "is not".
不 must come before 是, not after it.
是 is negated with 不, never with 没有.
Keep 是 between 她 and the noun: 她不是医生.

exercises.en: My friend doesn't like watching TV.
exercises.why: 不 goes right before the verb it negates, here 喜欢.

exercises.en: I'm not going to the hospital today.
exercises.why: The time word comes before or after the subject, and 不 goes right before the verb 去.
